verdict.rationale: Vercel exposes a REST API, CLI, and MCP tools that let a user or agent programmatically list/query many deployments, projects, or logs and could be scripted to act on multiple items, but there is no documented bulk-operation feature (e.g., batch delete/update/deploy across many items in one call) — only single-item operations (get_deployment, deploy_to_vercel, list_projects) are described. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or CLI commands, evidence of multi-item transactional actions, and confirmation that MCP tools support batched requests rather than one-at-a-time calls.
